==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsɛlə/|a=UK}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-seller.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsɛlɚ/|a=US}} {{enPR|sĕl-ər}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛlə(ɹ)|s=2}}
* {{homophones|en|cellar|sellar}}

===Etymology 1===
From {{inh|en|enm|seller}}, {{m|enm|sellere}}, (also {{m|enm|siller}}, {{m|enm|sullar}}, {{m|enm|sullere}}), from {{inh|en|ang|*sellere}}, {{m|ang|*syllere}}, equivalent to {{af|en|sell|-er<id:agent noun><pos:agent noun>}} (sense 1) and {{af|en|sell|-er<id:patient><pos:patient>}} (sense 2). Cognate with {{cog|da|sælger}}, {{cog|sv|säljare}}, {{cog|is|seljari||a seller; dealer}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# Someone who [[sell]]s; a [[vendor]]; a [[clerk]].
#: {{ux|en|Alisha was a '''seller''' of fine books.}}
#* {{RQ:Guardian|author=Oliver Milman|title=Are laboratory-grown diamonds the more ethical choice to say 'I do'?|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230825221918/https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/2020/mar/10/diamonds-lab-grown-climate-change|date=2020-03-10|passage=De Beers, the world’s largest diamond producer, announced plans in 2017 to operate a carbon-neutral mine and pointed out that the FTC has warned lab-grown diamond '''sellers''' over the veracity of their environmental claims.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Rishi Iyengar|title=Amazon wins legal fight against eBay over alleged seller poaching|url=https://www.cnn.com/2020/11/24/tech/amazon-ebay-seller-poaching-lawsuit/index.html|date=2020-11-24|passage=Amazon secured a major legal victory in its fight with rival eBay over '''seller''' poaching, with an arbitration panel ruling in its favor earlier this month, according to court filings by the company on Tuesday.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230324142420/https://www.cnn.com/2020/11/24/tech/amazon-ebay-seller-poaching-lawsuit/index.html|archivedate=24 March 2023}}
# Something which sells.
#: {{ux|en|Two of the books Alisha authored had become big '''sellers'''.}}
